pending.reason: A real run reaches two cohorts' assessments here, with revised plan and briefs, and reads integration as pending. Publishing integration needs each cohort complete: an operator's acceptance of its assessment and confirmation of a merge. This proof does not make those decisions on its own, so integration final is read only on the supplementary synthetic matrix until an operator decides whether a verification run may.

Correctness alone waits only when an assessment names a subject build observation has not captured. Live assessments are published with subject null, and the ordered feed captures any named subject before its assessment, so a real run cannot reach the split; it is proven offline in observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts. Reaching it live needs a product change.
